da-vacuous.notes: The branching statement is genuine representation theory; the Lean proves it via an explicit multiplicity table (not : True), with omega/rfl discharges of real arithmetic facts.

da-circular.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.md:64-71 maps m_μ/m_e to the 'V_(2) ↔ V_(1,1) transition (figure-eight volume)' and m_K/m_π to 'the same transition inside the entangled (2,1) block', then md:30-35 says Vol(4_1) 'measures the transition between these channels.'
da-circular.notes: The proposition's mathematical core (branching) is not circular, but the physics overlay assigns specific mass ratios (m_μ/m_e, m_K/m_π) to specific branching transitions by interpretive fiat — the identification 'this transition = that observed ratio' is asserted, not derived, and is downstream of the canonical-chain mass formula rather than established here. The identifications read as post-hoc labelling of an already-known branching with the target ratios. Minor because the block presents these as 'interpretation', not as a derivation of the numbers.

da-overclaim.evidence: The proposition body proves only the branching V_(2,1) ↓ = V_(2) ⊕ V_(1,1) (md:15-27; Lean standard_restricts_to_both_leptons). But md:65-76 elevates this to physical claims: 'The lepton mass ratio m_μ/m_e measures the separated transition', 'The meson mass ratio m_K/m_π measures the same transition inside the entangled block', 'The Hoefsmit off-diagonal b is the bridge ... At b→0: leptons; at b≠0: mesons (Hopf binding)', and md:88-94 'the meson mass lives (SDP active set)'. None of these mass-ratio / binding-amplitude claims are in the proven proposition or the Lean.
da-overclaim.notes: The PROVEN content is a standard ℕ-valued branching multiplicity (the block's own 'Mathematical Novelty' note at md:13 concedes the branching is 'standard representation theory'). The conclusion attaches lepton/meson MASS ratios, a binding amplitude b=√(a_ρ·a_{-ρ}+1), Hopf-link binding, and an SDP active set to it — a much stronger physical reading the argument does not support. The proposition kind asserts these via a 'Proposition' banner while the Lean carries none of them.

da-hidden-dof.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.md:42-46 introduces b = √(a_ρ·a_{-ρ}+1) with a_ρ = h/(1−q^{-2ρ}); ρ appears as an index with no definition, and h, ρ have no stated canonical-chain origin within the block (uses[] = prop:c-equals-bar-iff-all-1dim only).
da-hidden-dof.notes: The Hoefsmit off-diagonal formula imports parameters (h, ρ) whose provenance is not given here; ρ in particular (a content/charge of the partition?) is unindexed. Not necessarily a hidden free parameter — these are standard Hoefsmit-block quantities elsewhere in the corpus — but as presented in this block they have no derivation/reference, so a referee cannot confirm they are not tunable.

da-non-sequitur.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.md:62-71: from '⟨Res(V_(2,1)), V_(2)⟩ = 1' (each lepton irrep appears exactly once) the text concludes (1) 'the lepton mass ratio m_μ/m_e measures the separated transition' and (2) 'the meson mass ratio m_K/m_π measures the same transition inside the entangled block'. The 'each appears once' multiplicity does not entail anything about mass ratios.
da-non-sequitur.notes: The logical jump from a branching multiplicity (=1) to specific physical mass-ratio assignments is a non-sequitur: the Frobenius-reciprocity computation establishes a representation-theoretic fact; the identification with m_μ/m_e and m_K/m_π requires the mass formula + numerical evaluation (the canonical chain Steps 9–11), which is neither invoked nor cited here. The 'This means:' at md:63 introduces a missing lemma.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: The .ts lean.ref points to QOU.BraidsAndKnots.standard_restricts_to_both_leptons (frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.ts:7), which proves branchingH3H2 1 0 = 1 ∧ branchingH3H2 1 1 = 1 over a hand-entered ℕ table (frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.lean:44-54). The .md Proposition (md:1-12) plus its entanglement/mass-ratio/binding-amplitude claims (md:30-94) are far broader; the Lean does not formalize the irrep decomposition itself, only the multiplicities of a defined table, and proves NONE of the physics (b, mass ratios, SDP, C-vs-bar divergence).
da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: proof-statement-integrity: the Lean is a correct but weak combinatorial witness (a manually-specified branching table whose entries are asserted to 'follow from the Pieri rule' in a comment, not derived in Lean), whereas the .md proposition is a representation-isomorphism statement carrying a substantial physical superstructure. The Lean proves a strictly weaker, table-lookup version of only the first sentence of the proposition.

da-empirical-fragility.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.md:65-71 ties m_μ/m_e and m_K/m_π to branching transitions but states no numbers, no q₀ pin, and no witness; the block carries no computations/*.witness.json backing for the mass-ratio identifications.
da-empirical-fragility.notes: The mass-ratio claims are asserted purely structurally with zero numerical support, so they are neither confirmable nor falsifiable from this block — and per AGENTS.md the m_μ/m_e identification is q₀-pin-sensitive (muon vs proton anchor). A reader cannot tell whether the 'measures the transition' claims survive at the current q₀ pin. Flagged major because the proposition leans its physical significance on numerical matches it never exhibits or cites.

da-physical-implausibility.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.md:73-76 'b is ... the amplitude at which the lepton pair-channel becomes the meson binding channel. At b→0: leptons (no binding). At b≠0: mesons (Hopf binding).'
da-physical-implausibility.notes: Treating leptons and mesons as a single algebraic block continuously interpolated by an off-diagonal b is a strong physical identification (leptons are fundamental, mesons are q-qbar bound states) that a particle physicist would not accept as literally 'the same channel'. The block presents it as interpretation rather than measurement, so warn not fail; but the lepton↔meson continuity claim is physically non-standard and undefended.

da-reproducibility.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.lean:44-50: branchingH3H2 is a hand-entered table with comments 'These follow from the Pieri rule', not computed; no witness JSON is referenced for the b / a_ρ formulas (md:42-46).
da-reproducibility.notes: The branching multiplicities are asserted in a literal Lean table rather than derived, so 'reproducibility' rests on trusting the table matches Pieri (it does, by inspection). The binding-amplitude formula has no compute/witness to reproduce. No scriptHash/scriptCommitSha drift to assess since there is no producer; the gap is absence of backing, not staleness.

da-referee-verdict.evidence: frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.md:1-12 (proven core), md:30-94 (physical superstructure); frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.lean:44-54 (branching table); frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge.ts:7 (lean.ref to standard_restricts_to_both_leptons)
da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: major-revision. referee_argument: The proposition's proven content — the standard branching V_(2,1)↓ = V_(2)⊕V_(1,1), which the block itself labels 'standard representation theory' — is correct and well-formalized. But it is loaded with a physical superstructure (lepton/meson mass ratios m_μ/m_e and m_K/m_π identified with branching transitions, a binding amplitude b=√(a_ρ·a_{-ρ}+1), Hopf-link binding, SDP active set, C-vs-bar divergence) that the Proposition banner asserts yet neither the argument nor the Lean supports, with no numbers, witness, or q₀-pin disclosure. Per AGENTS.md §3a/§clarity-stmt-pure this interpretive material belongs in a follow-on remark, not inside a 'Proposition'. Strongest objection: the 'This means: mass ratio measures the transition' step (md:62-71) is a non-sequitur — a multiplicity-=1 branching fact cannot, alone, fix any mass ratio. Recommend demoting the physics to an interprets remark and keeping the proposition to the branching statement the Lean actually proves.
